scientific_integrity: The results concern a classical Ising model and are supported by explicit local inequalities and exact finite enumeration; no external validation or historical-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The universal theorem assumes a cubic base with a perfect matching, positive couplings, and homogeneous longitudinal field; critical one-spin-flip connectivity was checked only on the 12-spin truncated tetrahedron. An older equivalent Fisher-decorated graph statement may exist.
title: Universal one-third Ising plateau on triangle-expanded cubic graphs and the truncated tetrahedral critical census
